data.exact_reserve_text: The improvement in the combined operating ratio reflected a decrease in claims ratio (2015 53.7% versus 2014 57.1%), due to better than expected prior year development from within the Employers Liability and Public Liability classes, including a separate analysis of long-tail disease claims. The overall resultant benefit was a GBP 14,292,000 prior year contribution to the result (2014 GBP 23,233,000 adverse) on an annual accounting basis.

prior_year_events.impact_description: better than expected prior year development

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 14.292 million in 2015, contributing positively to the year's result. This favorable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience in Employers Liability and Public Liability classes, including a separate analysis of long-tail disease claims.
